{{Top|leg}}
'''Fouchiert''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Fouchiert worked to expose the actions of a [[Unidentified corrupt Republic commander|corrupt but effective commander]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], and was successfully able to convince his fellow senators of the commander's misdeeds.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Gone Too Far}}</ref>
